workload.runtime: DEVELOPMENT, through the revision's betaMode() flag
workload.network: Native in-process Luna Bot clients, registered as active world players. No human connections.
workload.spawn: 50 bots per 16 ground-level overworld centers. Jitter up to six tiles per axis, filtered for collision.
workload.seed_unavailable_reason: Native wandering uses revision-provided random sources without a seed setting.
workload.wander_action: SmartWanderingAction, NORMAL frequency, 18-tile rectangular radius. Native pathfinder and queue.
workload.wander_action_gate: Disables autonomous bot decisions for these temporary bots through the saved source patch.
workload.spawning: Up to 40 native login submissions each tick.
workload.background: Revision-supplied world and NPC definitions, actions and tasks. Auto-scheduled bot population zero.
workload.initial_data: Fresh detached worktree, verified cache, empty saves, JSON serializer, no database.
workload.cache_source: OpenRS2 cache 657, RuneScape live #377, 2006-05-02 (provided cache archive)
workload.spawn_validation: Terrain, live collision and eight open steps on every eligible spawn tile.
workload.participant_random_encounters: Benchmark-only guard where the revision has a random encounter tick hook.
